verses.text: Then the man led me north into the outer courtyard. He brought me to the rooms that faced the temple courtyard and the building on the north side.
This building was one hundred cubits long on the north side where its door was, and it was fifty cubits wide.
It faced the twenty-cubit space of the inner courtyard on one side and the pavement of the outer courtyard on the other. It had galleries facing each other on three levels.
In front of the rooms was a passage ten cubits wide and one hundred cubits long. Their doors faced north.
The upper rooms were narrower, because the galleries took more space from them than from the rooms on the lower and middle levels of the building.
The rooms were on three levels, and they had no pillars like the pillars in the courtyards. So the upper rooms were set back more than the lower and middle rooms.
There was an outer wall parallel to the rooms, facing the outer courtyard. It was fifty cubits long.
The row of rooms along the outer courtyard was fifty cubits long, while the row facing the temple was one hundred cubits long.
There was an entrance to these lower rooms on the east side, for people coming in from the outer courtyard.
On the south side, along the wall of the outer courtyard, facing the temple courtyard and the building, there were also rooms.
There was a passage in front of them, just like the rooms on the north side. They were the same length and width, with the same exits, layout, and doors.
The doors of the rooms on the south side were like these. There was a door at the start of the passage that ran along the wall on the east, where people entered the rooms.

Then he said to me, "The rooms on the north and south that face the temple courtyard are holy rooms. The priests who come near the LORD will eat the most holy offerings there. They will put the most holy offerings there: the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings, because the place is holy.

When the priests go into the holy place, they must not go out into the outer courtyard until they have taken off the clothes they wore while serving, because those clothes are holy. They must put on other clothes before they go near the area where the people are."
When he had finished measuring the inside of the temple area, he led me out through the gate facing east and measured the whole area all around.
He measured the east side with the measuring rod. It was five hundred rods long.
He measured the north side. It was five hundred rods long.
He measured the south side. It was five hundred rods long.
Then he turned to the west side and measured it. It was five hundred rods long.
So he measured the area on all four sides. It had a wall around it, five hundred long and five hundred wide, to separate what was holy from what was common.
